run_artifact_review.notes: Comment: 'no suitable overload found in catalog'. Duplicate using import. No real API call.

MergeOptions used but with InputPath/OutputPath properties (banned — these don't exist on MergeOptions). Should use AddInput(FileDataSource)/AddOutput(FileDataSource). Passed _validate_code check because properties were used instead of method pattern.

LLM defined a local class 'Merger' and 'MergerRequest' that shadows the real Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.Merger. Uses 'using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode' import but never calls the real API. build passes because local class is valid C#. This is NOT a LowCode example. _validate_code did not detect fake class.

merger.Process(new[] { inputPath1, inputPath2 }, outputPath, null) — this overload does not exist. _validate_code pattern '.Process(new [' (space) did NOT match '.Process(new[]' (no space). BUG IN VALIDATOR.

Uses TextAbsorber from Aspose.Pdf.Text namespace. No TextExtractor, no TextExtractorOptions, no Aspose.Pdf.LowCode usage. _validate_code did NOT detect because no TextAbsorber ban exists. This is the current package content.

extractor.Process(inputPath) — string argument overload does not exist. TextExtractorOptions NOT instantiated. _validate_code TextExtractorOptions check WOULD have caught this: 'TextExtractor in code and TextExtractorOptions not in code'. Validator worked for this case.

confirmed_validator_bugs.description: No check for 'TextAbsorber' in PDF examples. LLM can use Aspose.Pdf.Text.TextAbsorber and pass all current validators.
confirmed_validator_bugs.fix: Add: if family == 'pdf' and 'TextAbsorber' in code: errors.append('PDF: TextAbsorber is not the LowCode API. Use Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.TextExtractor with TextExtractorOptions.')

confirmed_validator_bugs.description: String array overload check pattern '.Process(new [' (space before bracket) does not match LLM output '.Process(new[]' (no space). Pattern never fires for this common hallucination.
confirmed_validator_bugs.fix: Change pattern to '.Process(new[' (no space) OR use regex r'\.Process\(new\s*\['

confirmed_validator_bugs.description: No check to detect fake local class shadowing real Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.Merger. LLM defined class 'Merger' locally in run 142605 and the validator did not catch it.
confirmed_validator_bugs.fix: Add: if family == 'pdf' and re.search(r'^\s*class\s+Merger\b', code, re.MULTILINE): errors.append('PDF: Local class Merger shadows Aspose.Pdf.LowCode.Merger. Remove local class definition.')
